svg.title: Stale healthcheck deletion: before and after the fix
svg.desc: An old healthcheck detects an alias mismatch. Before its cleanup runs, a replacement for the same tablet alias becomes healthy. Alias-only deletion cancels the replacement. The fix checks the originating healthcheck identity under the same mutex as deletion, so stale cleanup is ignored and the replacement survives. MySQL stays healthy in both cases.
svg.text: OLD and NEW are healthcheck instances for the same tablet alias, T.

svg.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; font-family: -apple-system-body, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; opacity: 1;

svg.title: Old cleanup arrives after the new healthcheck is healthy

desc.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; font-family: -apple-system-body, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; opacity: 1;

svg.desc: First, the old healthcheck encounters an error. Second, a new healthcheck takes over and becomes healthy. Third, the old worker finally requests deletion. Before the fix, deletion by tablet name cancels the healthy replacement. With the fix, the worker identity check rejects the old worker’s deletion and preserves the replacement.

svg.text: The fix checks identity and performs deletion under the same hc.mu lock.
MySQL stays healthy in both cases. The removed entry is in VTGate’s memory.
